request: What is the most common result of the music festival?
rewritten_request: What is the most common result of the music festival?
sql:
SELECT Result 
FROM music_festival 
GROUP BY Result 
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC 
LIMIT 1

request: Which club has the most members majoring in "600"?
rewritten_request: Which club has the most members majoring in "600"?
sql:
SELECT c.ClubName
FROM Club c
JOIN Member_of_club m ON c.ClubID = m.ClubID
JOIN Student s ON m.StuID = s.StuID
WHERE s.Major = 600
GROUP BY c.ClubName
ORDER BY COUNT(m.StuID) DESC
LIMIT 1

request: What is the party of the representative that has the smallest number of votes.
rewritten_request: What is the party of the representative that has the smallest number of votes.
sql:
SELECT r.Party
FROM representative r
JOIN election e ON r.Representative_ID = e.Representative_ID
ORDER BY e.Votes ASC
LIMIT 1

request: Which staff handled least number of payments? List the full name and the id.
rewritten_request: Which staff handled least number of payments? List the full name and the id.
sql:
SELECT s.first_name, s.last_name, s.staff_id
FROM staff s
JOIN payment p ON s.staff_id = p.staff_id
GROUP BY s.staff_id
ORDER BY COUNT(p.payment_id) ASC
LIMIT 1

request: Find the number of scientists involved for the projects that require more than 300 hours.
rewritten_request: Find the number of scientists involved for the projects that require more than 300 hours.
sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM AssignedTo 
WHERE Project IN (
  SELECT Code 
  FROM Projects 
  WHERE Hours > 300
)

request: Find the name and hours of project that has the most number of scientists.
rewritten_request: Find the name and hours of project that has the most number of scientists.
sql:
SELECT p.Name, p.Hours
FROM Projects p
JOIN AssignedTo a ON p.Code = a.Project
GROUP BY p.Code, p.Name, p.Hours
ORDER BY COUNT(a.Scientist) DESC
LIMIT 1

request: What are the names of representatives with more than 10000 votes in election?
rewritten_request: What are the names of representatives with more than 10000 votes in election?

request: Which complaint status has more than 3 records on file?
rewritten_request: Which complaint status has more than 3 records on file?

request: List the name of the phone model launched in year 2002 and with the highest RAM size.
rewritten_request: List the name of the phone model launched in year 2002 and with the highest RAM size.
sql:
SELECT p."Hardware_Model_name"
FROM "phone" p
JOIN "chip_model" c ON p."chip_model" = c."Model_name"
WHERE c."Launch_year" = 2002

LIMIT 1

request: Please show the date of ceremony of the volumes that last more than 2 weeks on top.

sql:

request: Which city has the highest temperature in February?

request: Find the first name of the band mate that has performed in most songs.

request: What are the songs in volumes with more than 1 week on top?

request: Find the accreditation level that more than 3 phones use.

request: Show the famous titles of the artists with both volumes that lasted more than 2 weeks on top and volumes that lasted less than 2 weeks on top.
rewritten_request: Show the famous titles of the artists with both volumes that lasted more than 2 weeks on top and volumes that lasted less than 2 weeks on top.
sql:
SELECT DISTINCT a.Famous_Title
FROM artist a
JOIN volume v ON a.Artist_ID = v.Artist_ID
WHERE v.Weeks_on_Top > 2
UNION
SELECT DISTINCT a.Famous_Title
FROM artist a
JOIN volume v ON a.Artist_ID = v.Artist_ID
WHERE v.Weeks_on_Top < 2

request: Find all the films longer than 100 minutes, or rated PG, except those who cost more than 200 for replacement. List the titles.
rewritten_request: Find all the films longer than 100 minutes, or rated PG, except those who cost more than 200 for replacement. List the titles.
sql:

FROM film f
WHERE f.length > 100
   OR f.rating = 'PG'

request: How many members of club "Bootup Baltimore" are younger than 18?
rewritten_request: How many members of club "Bootup Baltimore" are younger than 18?

request: Which film actors (actresses) played a role in more than 30 films? List his or her first name and last name.
rewritten_request: Which film actors (actresses) played a role in more than 30 films? List his or her first name and last name.
sql:

FROM actor a
JOIN film_actor fa ON a.actor_id = fa.actor_id
GROUP BY a.actor_id

request: Which customer, who has made at least one payment, has spent the least money? List his or her first name, last name, and the id.
rewritten_request: Which customer, who has made at least one payment, has spent the least money? List his or her first name, last name, and the id.
sql:
SELECT 
    c.first_name, 
    c.last_name, 
    c.customer_id
FROM 
    customer c
JOIN 
    payment p ON c.customer_id = p.customer_id
GROUP BY 
    c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name
ORDER BY 
    SUM(p.amount) ASC
LIMIT 1

request: List all complaints together with their environmental rating.
rewritten_request: List all complaints together with their environmental rating.
sql:
SELECT 
    c.complaint_id,
    c.complaint_outcome_code,
    c.complaint_status_code,
    c.complaint_type_code,
    c.date_complaint_raised,
    c.date_complaint_closed,
    c.staff_id,
    c.customer_id,
    c.product_id,
    p.product_name,
    p.product_category_code,
    p.product_price,
    CASE 
        WHEN p.product_category_code LIKE '%environmental%' THEN 'High'
        WHEN p.product_category_code LIKE '%sustainable%' THEN 'High'
        WHEN p.product_category_code LIKE '%eco%' THEN 'High'
        WHEN p.product_category_code LIKE '%green%' THEN 'High'
        ELSE 'Low'
    END AS environmental_rating
FROM 
    Complaints c
JOIN 
    Products p ON c.product_id = p.product_id
